protected_queries: all official test queries, including outside the ranking subset
normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse Unicode whitespace, within locale
validation_rounding: floor of eligible normalized groups per locale, clamped to [1, groups - 1]
selection: ascending SHA-256 of JSON [seed, locale, normalized query]; normalized query breaks ties
test_policy: preserve all original ranking test rows and original columns unchanged
exclusion_policy: exclude complete training query groups matching a protected locale-query ID or locale-normalized query
